title: events/types/retry.gate.evaluated
description: Payload for event_type 'retry.gate.evaluated' (native type, feature 003; FR-203/FR-205): the gate verdict over the post-window observed state. predicates carry per-predicate {id, field, expected, observed, met}; early_exit mirrors passed -- a pass ends retries for this window.

gate_ref.description: Gate identifier from the retry config.

observed.description: Value read from the observed state; null when the field was missing.

early_exit.description: True when the gate passed and remaining retries are skipped (FR-203).
